courses.title: Strategic Oversight for Consulting Directors
courses.description: By the end of Strategic Oversight for Consulting Directors, you'll be able to apply strategic oversight confidently in Consulting Director work, with a working sense of where business process analysis fits alongside it. The course moves from core strategic oversight technique through a few applied exercises, with a lighter look at business process analysis woven in throughout.
learning_outcomes: Applying strategic oversight to a real Consulting Director scenario
Practicing strategic oversight through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to business process analysis
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Client Relationship Management for Practitioners
courses.description: Client Relationship Management for Practitioners is a focused course on client relationship management for people already working toward a Consulting Director role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying client relationship management on your own.
